```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

#Setup
```{r}
for (lib in c('tidyverse', 'ggrepel')) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(lib, character.only = TRUE))
}
```

#1) Read in the 16S data
```{r}
taxonomy <- read_tsv('taxonomy_16S.tsv')
maaslin <- read_tsv("all_results_maaslin2_16s.tsv")
```

#2) Plot the 16s
```{r}
#Set up data for plotting
rVs <- maaslin %>%
  mutate(feature = gsub("^X", "", feature)) %>% #Maaslin adds 'X' infront of IDs starting with numbers, removing those to match with taxonomy
  left_join(taxonomy, by = c("feature" = "ASV_ID")) %>%
  mutate(enrich = ifelse(qval > 0.2, "NO",
                  ifelse(coef > 0, "UP",
                  ifelse(coef < 0, "DW", NA)))) #denote which samples are enriched in either condition
#pull top  differentially expressed
t30 <- head(rVs[order(rVs$qval), "feature"], 20) #pull top N features, originally top 30 (t30) but that was a lot

#add as new column to use when labeling
#rVs$delabel <- ifelse(rVs$feature %in% t30$feature, sub(".*;\\s*", "", rVs$Family), NA) 
rVs$delabel <- ifelse(
  rVs$feature %in% t30$feature,
  case_when(
    is.na(rVs$Genus) & is.na(rVs$Family) & is.na(rVs$Order) ~ rVs$Class,
    is.na(rVs$Genus) & is.na(rVs$Family)                    ~ rVs$Order,
    is.na(rVs$Genus) | rVs$Genus == "g__uncultured"         ~ rVs$Family,
    #is.na(rVs$Family) | rVs$Family == "f__Unknown_Family" ~ rVs$Order,
    TRUE                                                    ~ sub(".*;\\s*", "", rVs$Genus)
  ),
  NA)

#remove label from non top N features
top <- head(rVs, n=20)

#number of asvs
n_sbc <- maaslin %>%
  filter(qval < 0.2 & coef < 0) %>%
  nrow()

n_ifg <- maaslin %>%
  filter(qval < 0.2 & coef > 0) %>%
  nrow()

#Generate the plot
volcano_16 <- ggplot(data = rVs, aes(x = coef, y = -log10(qval), col = enrich, label = delabel)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "grey", linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.2), col = "grey", linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5,5), ylim = c(0,8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("goldenrod2", "grey", "darkcyan"), # to set the colors of our variable
                     labels = c("SBC", "Not Significant", "IFG")) + # to set the labels we want to overwrite the categories from the dataframe (DOWN, NO, UP)
  labs(color = 'Material', #legend_title,<br />
       x = 'Effect Size', y = expression("-log"[10]*"q-value")) +
  geom_text_repel(stat = 'identity', max.overlaps = Inf, size = 5) +
  annotate("text", x = I(0.1), y = -log10(0.2) + 0.2, label = paste(n_sbc,"ASVs"), color = "goldenrod2", size = 6) + 
  annotate("text", x = I(0.9), y = -log10(0.2) + 0.2, label = paste(n_ifg, "ASVs"), color = "darkcyan", size = 6) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(position = 'inside')) +
  theme(text=element_text(size=18),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = 'none'
        )

#volcano_16
```

#3) Read in the 18S data
```{r}
taxonomy_18 <- read_csv('taxonomy_18S.csv')
maaslin_18 <- read_tsv("all_results_maaslin2_18s.tsv")
```

#4) Plot the 18s data
```{r}
#Set up data for plotting
rVs <- maaslin_18 %>%
  mutate(feature = gsub("^X", "", feature)) %>% #Maaslin adds 'X' infront of IDs starting with numbers, removing those to match with taxonomy
  left_join(taxonomy_18, by = c("feature" = "ASV_ID")) %>%
  mutate(enrich = ifelse(qval > 0.2, "NO",
                  ifelse(coef > 0, "UP",
                  ifelse(coef < 0, "DW", NA)))) #denote which samples are enriched in either condition
#pull top  differentially expressed
t30 <- head(rVs[order(rVs$qval), "feature"], 20) #pull top N features
#add as new column to use when labeling
rVs$delabel <- ifelse(
  rVs$feature %in% t30$feature,
  case_when(
    is.na(rVs$Genus) & is.na(rVs$Family) & is.na(rVs$Order) ~ rVs$Class,
    is.na(rVs$Genus) & is.na(rVs$Family)                    ~ rVs$Order,
    is.na(rVs$Genus) | rVs$Genus == "g__uncultured"         ~ rVs$Family,
    #is.na(rVs$Family) | rVs$Family == "f__Unknown_Family" ~ rVs$Order,
    TRUE                                                    ~ sub(".*;\\s*", "", rVs$Genus)
  ),
  NA)

#pull the labled features
top <- head(rVs, n=20)

#number of asvs
n_sbc <- maaslin_18 %>%
  filter(qval < 0.2 & coef < 0) %>%
  nrow()

n_ifg <- maaslin_18 %>%
  filter(qval < 0.2 & coef > 0) %>%
  nrow()

#Generate the plot
volcano_18 <- ggplot(data = rVs, aes(x = coef, y = -log10(qval), col = enrich, label = delabel)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, col = "grey", linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.2), col = "grey", linetype = 'dashed') + #significance line
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("goldenrod2", "grey", "darkcyan"), # to set the colors of our variable
                     labels = c("SBC", "Not Significant", "IFG")) + # to set the labels we want to overwrite the categories from the dataframe (DW, NO, UP)
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4,4), ylim = c(0,8)) +
  labs(color=NULL,
       x = 'Effect Size', y = expression("-log"[10]*"q-value")) +
  geom_text_repel(stat = 'identity', max.overlaps = Inf, size = 5) +
  annotate("text", x = I(0.1), y = -log10(0.2) + 0.2, label = paste(n_sbc,"ASVs"), color = "goldenrod2", size = 6) + 
  annotate("text", x = I(0.9), y = -log10(0.2) + 0.2, label = paste(n_ifg, "ASVs"), color = "darkcyan", size = 6) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(position = 'inside')) +
  theme(text=element_text(size=18),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #make the inside of the plot blank
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), #move legend inside the plot
        legend.justification.inside = c(.99, 0.01)
        )

#volcano_18
```

#5 Combine the two plots
```{r 5.a combine the plots}
volcano.2 <- ggarrange(volcano_16, volcano_18,
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 1,
                    align = 'h',
                    labels = 'auto',
                    font.label = list(size = 20, color = 'black', face = 'bold', family = NULL))
```

```{r 5.b save the final plot}
ggsave(
  filename="Volcano_Main.pdf",
  plot = volcano.2,
  dpi = 1000,
  width = 360,
  height = 180,
  units = 'mm'
)
```
